sentiment.rationale: The document reports full-year 2025 revenue of $65.2B (up 45%) and non-GAAP EPS of $24.21 (up 86%), with Q4 revenue up 43% and key products up 91%. Forward guidance for 2026 revenue of $80B to $83B (about 25% growth at the midpoint) and EPS of $33.50 to $35.00 represents a material raise relative to the prior year's performance, supported by the launch of Foundayo (orforglipron) and supply expansion. Pricing drag and Medicaid coverage losses are noted as secondary concerns but do not offset the strong forward trajectory.
